a: WebSocket starts as HTTP Upgrade then switches to a full-duplex socket.
Data is sent in frames (text/binary) with opcodes and optional masking.
Socket.IO adds fallbacks, rooms, and reconnection on top of WebSocket-like transport.
Scale with sticky sessions or a pub/sub bus so messages reach the right node.
Authenticate on connect via token query/header then authorize per message.
SSE is server-to-client over HTTP; WebSocket is bidirectional.
Clients should reconnect with backoff and resume state after disconnects.
Rooms/channels group connections for targeted broadcasts.
If clients are slow, buffer limits and drop/slow producers to avoid OOM.
